items.headline: $CAKE Eyes 69% Emissions Cut in Bold PancakeSwap Revamp
items.summary: PancakeSwap proposes sending 88% of LP fees to the treasury and slashing $CAKE emissions by 69%, while keeping v2's burn mechanism intact.

items.headline: $HEX Founder Richard Heart Detained in Istanbul
items.summary: Turkish media report $HEX and PulseChain founder Richard Heart was detained on an Interpol notice from Finland over aggravated tax fraud. $4M and 64 watches were reportedly seized.

items.headline: $UNCX Vesting Pool Exploited for $86K, Blockaid Says
items.summary: An attacker drained five tokens from a $UNCX vesting pool on Ethereum. The affected contract still held about $3.25M in assets.

items.headline: $BABY Pushes Native Bitcoin Collateral for Aave V4
items.summary: Babylon's proposal would keep BTC collateral on Bitcoin while using WBTC for permissionless liquidations on Aave V4. Governance votes are still pending.

items.headline: $EQX Plans 11 Tokenized Stock Markets on Hyperliquid
items.summary: $EQX aims to launch 11 share-backed stock and ETF tokens trading against USDC on HyperCore, with US persons excluded under eligibility rules.
